Topics covered in this PDF

BSOC-104 (Sociology of India-II) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Plural foundations of Indian society, Sanskritization, Westernization and secularization, peasant movements, nationalism in India, fundamentalism and communalism
  • Macaulay's Minute on Education, constitutional foundations of India, women's movements, working class movements, protective discrimination

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: total marks 100, three sections, answer all questions. Section I: two descriptive questions in about 500 words (20 each). Section II: three middle category questions in about 250 words (10 each). Section III: five short category questions in about 100 words (6 each)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
